wholePhysicalScope: Named Clifton palace outline, four individual turret footprints and two exact public-domain photographs.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the two-tone palace, four corner chhatris and five-domed roof pavilion. Near levels add recessed arches, entrance tilework and rooftop rails.
limitations: The restored exterior is represented using the May 2005 camera date. The August 2008 entrance photo contributes the doorway and tile decoration in the same restored museum period.

The mapped building and turret footprints fix the main position and scale. Front windows, corner chhatris and dome grouping follow the photographs. Unseen elevations, roof joinery, ornament, tile motifs and dome heights are estimates.
The terrain field is unchanged. Local heights and the masonry threshold are approximate. The estate walls, lawns and neighboring buildings are outside the model.
